enum.bridgeResilienceLimit.0: Free-flow model time, excluding congestion. These are single-bridge failure consequences, not risk (no hazard probability).
enum.bridgeResilienceLimit.1: Population is registered population, not actual trips. Day/night populations are simulated and for comparison only.
enum.bridgeResilienceLimit.2: Danjiang Bridge's interchange ramps are removed together (whether they count as part of the bridge is to be confirmed), so the metrics are an upper bound.
